After the snapshot-source correction was requested, OPPO returned 10 rows, down from 20; the previous visible repeated type/duration patterns are absent. Six rows display durations (appLaunch 1532ms, firstRender 701ms, evaluateScript 4ms, plus redacted render/interaction values); route and the three paint/content timing points have no duration. The report does not embed its probe revision. No FPS/frame metric was reported, and the user reports no frame-rate item in the IDE Tools menu.
